title: Birdie Time Pub
specs: Indoor 9-hole mini golf course themed after PNW sports teams
Golf and sports simulator with 13 interactive sport experiences and 100+ courses worldwide
Mini Golf To Go: age 5 and up
Kids 12 and under must be accompanied by an adult on the course at all times
Golf and Game Simulator is for ages 12+
Facility buyout minimum 3 hours; unavailable Friday 3pm to Sunday 4pm
includes: 30 putters and balls included with Mini Golf To Go rental
Set-up and breakdown included in Mini Golf To Go rental price
Unlimited use of 9-hole mini golf course and golf and game simulator with facility buyout
blurb: Guests can play a 9-hole mini golf course indoors, use a golf and sports simulator with over 100 courses, and enjoy a sports bar with 35+ Pacific Northwest craft beers and cocktails. The venue offers event space rentals, catering, and a family-friendly atmosphere until 7pm. Mini golf is available for walk-ins and private events, with yearly memberships and portable mini golf rentals for off-site events.
extraNote: 50% refund if Mini Golf To Go canceled prior to 14 days; full refund with cancellation insurance if canceled at least 72 hours prior · Mini Golf To Go bookings must be made at least 14 days prior to event · Mini Golf To Go requires tent covering if raining · No reservations needed for walk-in mini golf; event reservations accepted up to 24 hours prior
